description: Get All Vouchers. Part of the Get All APIs in Giddh. Requires portal session.

count.description: Page size (number of items returned). Default: 20. Optional.

type.description: Voucher or entity type discriminator for the list. Default: sales. Optional.

noteType.description: Credit/debit note subtype when the route supports it. Optional.

sort.description: Sort direction. Allowed values: asc, desc. Default: desc. Optional.

sortBy.description: Field name to sort by. Default: voucherDate. Optional.

voucherCount.description: Voucher count query parameter. Default: 20. Optional.

q.description: Search text (case sensitivity depends on the endpoint). Optional.

branchUniqueName.description: Branch uniqueName; omit for default company branch behaviour. Optional.
